description_en: Queries the hybrid cloud SDK servers that are managed by a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-sdk-servers --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-i7m20000b --ip '1.0.01。' --host-name online-000wwq --cluster-name testcluster --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudSdkServers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance

WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the hybrid cloud SDK server that you want to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the hybrid cloud SDK server that you want to query
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the hybrid cloud cluster that you want to query
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。
